files.README.md:
# Skarnfell Quarry - washing plant shift wrapper

Each crushing shift is wrapped in one shell script. The operator reads crusher.log the next morning,
so the file must keep everything written on earlier shifts instead of being replaced.
files.notes/shift-handover.txt:
Shift log review happens at 06:40 in the weighbridge office.
Errors from the belt sensor are read out of the same file as the ordinary progress lines.
